meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Also covers Tailwind projects and the STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plan formats. Read before writing composition HTML.

copy.tagline: 构建可渲染的合成项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用HyperFrames框架构建合成项目
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building composition projects with HyperFrames

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按照 HyperFrames 规范生成可渲染的 HTML 视频项目。它会帮你搭建合成结构、设置时间属性、管理轨道和子合成，并确保媒体播放和动画符合确定性渲染规则。
howto.when: 当你要求构建一个 HyperFrames 视频项目，或需要编写合成 HTML、设置时间轴、添加子合成时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个最小可渲染的 HyperFrames 合成骨架。
say.note: Claude 会生成一个基础 HTML 文件。

say.text: 在这个合成里添加一个子合成，并设置它的 data-composition-id。
say.note: Claude 会指导你如何正确嵌套子合成。

say.text: 检查这个合成是否符合确定性渲染规则。
say.note: Claude 会验证是否有禁止的运行时行为。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will generate renderable HTML video projects following HyperFrames specifications. It helps build composition structure, set timing attributes, manage tracks and sub-compositions, and ensure media playback and animations comply with deterministic-render rules.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to build a HyperFrames video project, or need to write composition HTML, set up timelines, or add sub-compositions.

say_en.text: Create a minimal renderable HyperFrames composition skeleton.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a basic HTML file.

say_en.text: Add a sub-composition to this composition and set its data-composition-id.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you on proper nesting.

say_en.text: Check if this composition follows deterministic-render rules.
say_en.note: Claude will verify prohibited runtime behaviors.
